2014_spells.guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.
2014_spells.guidance.effectSummary: Change a target: it can roll the die before or after making the ability check
2014_spells.guidance.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch one willing creature. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check; Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
